title: Schooling and listening to a 1960 old-style band recording
summary: A question about school goes unanswered; Ridgley hears a June 1960 recording with Peter Bocage and Charlie Love and calls it the old style.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school
